description:
-= Cookery =-
You arrive in a cookery. An usual kind of place.

You lean against the wall, inadvertently pressing a secret button. The wall opens up to reveal a case. The case contains a loaf of bread. You can see a table. Make a note of this, you might have to put stuff on or in it later on. However, the table, like an empty table, has nothing on it. This always happens!

You don't like doors? Why not try going west, that entranceway is unblocked.
objective: Hey, thanks for coming over to the TextWorld today, there is something I need you to do for me. First of all, you could, like, retrieve the loaf of bread from the case inside the cookery. And then, eat the loaf of bread. And once you've done that, you win!
